items.name: Order book EUR 8,976 million, end of H1 2026
items.claim: Wartsila's order book at the end of the period increased by 13% to EUR 8,976 million (7,963), as reported in its half-year financial report.
items.source_excerpt: The order book at the end of the period increased by 13% to EUR 8,976 million (7,963)

items.name: 1.2 GW of firm data centre-related orders across two projects, Q2 2026
items.claim: In Energy, order intake surpassed the previous all-time high set in the first quarter of 2026 by more than 70%, largely as a result of 1.2 GW of firm data centre-related orders across two projects and more than 0.5 GW in balancing orders.
items.source_excerpt: In Energy, order intake surpassed the previous all-time high set in the first quarter of 2026 by more than 70%, largely as a result of 1.2 GW of firm data centre-related orders across two projects and more than 0.5 GW in balancing orders.

items.name: Sustainable Technology Hub capacity expansion, commissioning Q1 2029
items.claim: During the quarter, Wartsila announced a further expansion of production capacity at its Sustainable Technology Hub (STH); once fully commissioned in the first quarter of 2029, the expansion will increase output to approximately 2.2 times the 2025 operational level.
items.source_excerpt: During the quarter, we announced a further expansion of production capacity at our Sustainable Technology Hub (STH), strengthening our ability to meet growing global demand. Once fully commissioned in the first quarter of 2029, the expansion will increase output to approximately 2.2 times the 2025 operational level.

notes: H1 2026 stock exchange release (stored, HTTP 200) discloses a group-level order book figure, a quantified Energy data-centre order batch, and the STH capacity-expansion project; none of it is specific to ice-class propulsion (the arctic-sea-route link ICEPOD sits in Marine), which the release does not break out separately.
